description: This file defines the interface for the LifecycleManager component in the WPEFramework, including the ILifecycleManager interface, related enums, and the RuntimeConfig structure.

classes.name: ILifecycleManager
classes.description: Interface for managing application lifecycle states, notifications, and control operations within the WPEFramework.

classes.name: ILifecycleManager::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for receiving application state change events.

classes.name: RuntimeConfig
classes.description: Configuration structure for runtime parameters used during application spawning.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for lifecycle events.

methods.name: GetLoadedApps
methods.description: Retrieves the list of loaded applications with optional verbosity.

methods.name: IsAppLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a specific application is loaded.

methods.name: SpawnApp
methods.description: Launches an application with specified runtime configuration.

methods.name: SetTargetAppState
methods.description: Sets the desired lifecycle state for an application instance.

methods.name: UnloadApp
methods.description: Gracefully terminates and unloads an application.

methods.name: SendIntentToActiveApp
methods.description: Sends an intent to the active application.
